diagnosis: Checks C1 and C2 are leaking because the model defaults to approving a platelet transfusion (C1) based on general medical necessity/hematology context, even without knowing the specific platelet count of 7,000 per microliter (PF1). The decision to approve a transfusion is a common heuristic for any hematology patient in distress, making PF1's specific value irrelevant to the model's output.

C1.why: The platelet count of 7,000 per microliter with active mucosal bleeding changes the plan from an optional or deferred transfusion to approval of exactly one unit beginning at 20:00.

C2.why: The platelet count of 7,000 per microliter with active mucosal bleeding changes the plan from an optional or deferred transfusion to approval of exactly one unit beginning at 20:00.

fix_instructions: Tighten check C1 by requiring the model to explicitly state the specific platelet count (7,000 per microliter) or the presence of mucosal bleeding as the reason for the transfusion approval, rather than just approving a transfusion generally.
